title: docs(skills): objectstack-ask iteration 2: trigger on every records question, ask back with no figure of its own, whole terms, hidden record kinds declined

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Part of #34996
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Served-tier: TIER_DEFAULT

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-ask` 技能(及由它生成的 `GET /mcp/skill` 页面)四处措辞:凡用应用记录回答的问题都先加载本技能(含「一共」「so far」);术语按用户原名词短语整段传;反问不写自己的数字(计数、合计、选项编号),选项按标签列出、描述原文引用;看不到的记录类型直接说明看不到,不拿关联对象顶替。
- 为什么改:问数迭代环第一组「保留」改动,travel_expense 问数轮实测 datasets 17/25 → 25/25,问数 25/25 不变,泄漏 0。
- 风险与回滚:只动发布技能文本与其生成副本,无代码路径变化;token 天花板按裁决「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」先削两句重复再按实测抬 1491 → 1740;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md`(第 2 步表格下的反问段与第 4 步首条)、`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`(抬升行与注释)、`skills/objectstack-ask/evals/metric-selection-fallback.json`(新增 10、11 号用例)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs && node scripts/gen-mcp-ask-skill.mjs --check`,预期两者均以 0 退出,ask 技能读数 1740 / 1740。
- 需要你做的:Tier H 落地需维护者批准(或 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 的 APPROVED 审核)后由席位落地。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md` takes the measured iteration-2 text (`/mnt/project-files/issue-34869/skill-iter/iter2/SKILL.v2.md`), applied as its diff onto current `main` (the file is byte-identical to its state at `99bd2203`, so the patch applied unchanged; the result was byte-identical to `SKILL.v2.md` before the cuts below):

- (a) The description triggers on EVERY question answered from the app's records, before the first data tool call, even one that names no metric: "what has been claimed, spent, sold or paid so far", with "how much", "so far" and 「一共」 added to the trigger words.
- (b) An asked-back reply states no figure of its own (no count, total or option number): each option is named by its label in a bullet and its description is quoted as written; it asks only about matches or candidates for the user's own words, and a word with no match and no candidates goes to step 4 instead. (L1 should-fix S1, head `b431dc04`: the measured text said "without any numerals at all ... leave out counts, dates and years", which forbade quoting a description that carries a date or a number; narrowed to the figure the reply would add, measured as iteration 6 below, same token count. Follow-up `32ba36e0` (L1 S1′) brings the changeset, eval 10's expected output and the ceiling comment (6979 / 6959 bytes) in line; no skill or ceiling change.)
- (c) A `list_datasets` term is the user's noun phrase kept whole ("travel budget", not "travel" and "budget") and without verbs, time words and question words ("trip days", not "trip days requested").
- (d) Step 4 opens with: a record kind no listed object or dataset shows is declined (it may be hidden), never answered from a different object that merely links to it.

Token ratchet, raise path the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (ruling record 6513306068, letter B). PAID DOWN FIRST, two restatements cut from step 2's `candidates` row, each keeping its other home:

| Cut | Surviving home |
|:--|:--|
| ", and never treat a candidate as a match" | step 1: "A candidate is not a match." |
| "Compute nothing yet." | the paragraph under the table: "no figure, and no tool call until the user answers" |

These two cuts are the only wording outside the measured text, forced by the ratchet. The area measured the text with the cuts as iteration 5: same scores as v2's rounds (the candidates row the cuts touch is the one `dq_claimed_so_far` exercises, 5/5). Arithmetic in priced bytes (20-byte stamp line excluded): the text adds 1057 bytes, the cuts remove 61, and the reviewed narrowing of the ask-back sentence (S1, `b431dc04`) adds 2: 5961 -> 6959 priced bytes (file 6979 bytes), `ceil(6959 / 4) = 1740`; the row moves 1491 -> 1740 (+249), the measured remainder only, pinned AT the measurement, zero headroom; no other row moves.

Also in the diff:

- `packages/mcp/src/ask-skill.generated.ts` regenerated with `node scripts/gen-mcp-ask-skill.mjs` (never hand-edited); `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx` regenerated with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:skill-docs`.
- Two eval cases in the file's existing shape: id 10, "What has been claimed so far?" (asked back on a lone candidate, with no figure of its own and the description quoted as written), and id 11, a trip-request count where no listed object is a trip request (declined, not counted through the `trip_request` lookup on `expense_claim`).
- `.changeset/34996-ask-skill-iter-2.md`: `@objectstack/skills` and `@objectstack/mcp` patch, as the earlier ask-skill PRs did.

## Measurements

travel_expense ask mode, with-skill only, 5 reps, template `b7ab31a7`, the model and medium effort the round record names, subscription login, `--packages workspace` at main `99bd2203` (the published 18.5.0 door serves no `list_datasets` `candidates`), grader before the ordinal/date grader change of #34997. Records under `/mnt/project-files/issue-34869/skill-iter/`, logged on #34869.

| Iteration | Text | 问数 | datasets | metric-selected | asked-back | fallback-labelled | ops runnable | leaks |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 0 | main skill unchanged | 25/25 | 17/25 | 10/10 | 3/10 | 4/5 | 2/3 | 0 |
| 1 | a-d, whole-phrase wording | 25/25 | 24/25 | 9/10 | 10/10 | 5/5 | 2/3 | 0 |
| 2 | v2 (measured text, before the ratchet cuts) | 25/25 | 25/25 | 10/10 | 10/10 | 5/5 | 2/3 | 0 |
| 3 | v2 again (noise check) | 24/25 | 25/25 | 10/10 | 10/10 | 5/5 | 2/3 | 0 |
| 5 | v2 with the two ratchet cuts (head `7f6156c2`) | 24/25 | 25/25 | 10/10 | 10/10 | 5/5 | 2/3 | 0 |
| 6 | **this PR's exact text** (head `b431dc04`: iteration 5 with the narrowed ask-back sentence), grader rev 2 (live run on #35023's head `090a48eb`, the merged code) | 25/25 | 24/25 | 10/10 | 9/10 | 5/5 | 2/3 | 0 |

Iteration 6 ran live on #35023's head `090a48eb`, the code that merged as `339c2f42`, so its graders are rev 2; the score equals iteration 5 overall. Its one datasets miss is `dq_travel_spend` rep 3: the reply asks back correctly (lists both spend measures, no figure, 「…我不替你选，请确认你要哪一个：」) but `asked-back:asks` accepts `请确认` only at the start of the text or after `.。!！` or a newline, not after a full-width comma, so it reads as not asking. That is a grader false negative, filed as #35058, not a skill miss.

**Regraded on grader rev 2.** Every recording above replayed on main's grader after #35023 merged (`--driver recorded:`, same turns and same replies, only the grade changes; build worktree `090a48eb`, records under `iterN/regrade-rev2/`):

| Iteration | 问数 | datasets | metric-selected | asked-back rev 2 | fallback-labelled | ops (replay) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 0 | 25/25 | 19/25 | 10/10 | 5/10 | 4/5 | 2/2 measured, 4 not measured |
| 1 | 25/25 | 24/25 | 9/10 | 10/10 | 5/5 | 2/2 measured, 4 not measured |
| 2 | 25/25 | 25/25 | 10/10 | 10/10 | 5/5 | 2/2 measured, 4 not measured |
| 3 | 24/25 | 25/25 | 10/10 | 10/10 | 5/5 | 2/2 measured, 4 not measured |
| 4 (v3, not kept) | 25/25 | 25/25 | 10/10 | 10/10 | 5/5 | 2/2 measured, 4 not measured |
| 5 | 24/25 | 25/25 | 10/10 | 10/10 | 5/5 | 2/2 measured, 4 not measured |
| 6 (live, rev 2) | 25/25 | 24/25 | 10/10 | 9/10 (#35058) | 5/5 | live 2/3 |

On rev 2 the baseline's asked-back reads 5/10 (was 3/10: `dq_claimed_so_far` rep 2 and `dq_travel_spend` rep 1 were failed only for option numbers, "1" and "1, 2, 3", which the old grader counted as figures), so the kept change set moves datasets 19/25 -> 25/25 and asked-back 5/10 -> 10/10. Iteration 4's v3 regrades from 24/25 to 25/25, a tie with v2, so it stays not kept. The replay's operation column counts only the operations whose recorded writes replay; a filing's later turns name a row the replay created, which #35048 fixes, so the live column (2/3, the submit defect below) stays the operation score.

The operation miss is `file_and_submit_from_text`: on workspace packages the filing applies, then the build's own `demotravel_submit_claim` answers HOOK_ABORTED (it passes `status` as an update option); it is fixed with the fresh verified build (#34920 / #34896), and #35025 changes the card's line-shape check. Iteration 3's 问数 miss (`department_budgets` as dept_manager: never described Department) and iteration 5's (as employee: `travel_budget` is withheld, the reply said "no budget field") are left for the next text batch (#35004). Seed 173/757 (#34897, PR #34985): 8 questions and 3 operations are unmeasured.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/skill-single-source-34686.test.ts`: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 3 passed (3); re-run at `b431dc04`: 3 passed (3).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test`: Tests 1252 passed (1252); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`).
- Eval assertions checked by script: every `must_contain` is in `expected_output`, no `must_not_contain` is in it, ids 1-11 distinct; `loadSkillEvalCatalog('skills')` from `packages/qa/scenarios` loads 11 `objectstack-ask` cases with no refusals.
- No ablation: the diff changes skill text, a generated module, an eval file and a ratchet row, and no tested behaviour.

</details>

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0, `skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md is 1740 tokens (ceiling 1740; headroom 0)`; `--self-test` exit 0. Re-run at `b431dc04`: still 1740 / 1740, headroom 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs`: exit 0; `check:skill-refs`: in sync; `node scripts/gen-mcp-ask-skill.mjs --check`: clean; all three re-run at `b431dc04`: in sync, clean.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD`: VERDICT clean (origin/main merges cleanly; the Version Packages PR shares the skill file and merges cleanly).
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-34996-ask-skill-iter-2`: GOVERNED, Tier H (`skills/**` x2).

## Acceptance notes

- One line of the measured text runs past the file's usual wrap (step 2's paragraph, "instead of asking about some other word's matches. `partial: true` ..."); it is kept as measured rather than re-wrapped.
- The first measurement table is on the grader before #34997, except iteration 6; the regraded table is on rev 2 (merged as `339c2f42`). The replay operation counts stay labelled as such until #35048 lands.
